era.title: INDUSTRIAL
era.blurb: Furnaces, shift bells, the foreman's eye.

commands.name: RAISE THE QUOTA
commands.text: Output up by a fifth. The line is already hot.

commands.name: RING THE SHIFT BELL
commands.text: Bells at dawn, bells at dusk. Rest is a rented hour.

commands.name: INSTALL THE FOREMAN'S EYE
commands.text: Every bench watched. Trust becomes a line item.

commands.name: OFFER THE BONUS
commands.text: A coin for a faster hand. Who counts the missing fingers?

closing.synthesis: The machine and the hand found a pace neither owns.
closing.no_synthesis: The line kept running. Nobody agreed to it.
